implementation: Inline the existing InvokeNativeTarget adapter so ordinary returns avoid an external adapter call and intermediate expected/Value copies
Keep enum allocation and type resolution in the existing native_call implementation through internal::BoxNativeEnumResult
Add generated-entry and target-adapter layer benchmarks for arithmetic/calls/host, plus C++ direct and indirect arithmetic controls

measurement.unit: nanoseconds per complete invocation; calls/host each execute 1000 inner steps
measurement.aggregation: Median and sample CV of every iteration sample; no outlier filtering
measurement.external_load: User confirmed external jobs had completed before these two measured runs; full regression/lint started afterwards
limitations: Complete AOT workload includes benchmark Sample/expected/string result handling; generated and target layers separate that overhead
Generated entry and C++ direct/indirect controls have different runtime contracts; their ratios are descriptive
C++ calls uses noinline PlainStep, while generated script calls may inline; do not interpret its ratio as equal function-call cost
C++ calls control shifted by about 17%; its before/after ratio trend is not attributed to the production optimization
The tiny complete C++ arithmetic baseline has sample CV above 10%; arithmetic native layers and C++ direct/indirect controls have CV below 1%, and complete C++ median drift is below 1%
Earlier exploratory and loaded matched runs are excluded from performance conclusions because unchanged C++ controls drifted substantially

suite.description: Arithmetic entry layers with calls/host controls and C++ complete workloads
